NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author posted two screenshots in a comment and said the description is updated. There was no new push, and the description still has the "Screenshots to be added by author in comments" placeholder.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | Screenshots were posted as a comment, not in the description. One looks like a desktop view and one a ~533px mobile view. |
| ❌  | No before/after screenshots at different widths, which the issue (#40051) explicitly asks for. |
| ❌  | The description still has the "Screenshots to be added by author in comments" placeholder. The self-review boxes for strings/tooltips and corner cases are unchecked. |
| ℹ️  | An earlier open PR (#40052) touches the same file and has not been resolved. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for before/after screenshots at several widths in the PR description.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Please put them in the PR description, replacing the placeholder, and show clear before/after comparisons at several narrow widths, as described in [our guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html). Please also complete the remaining self-review checklist items.
```
